messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-ALERT 2024-10-12T09:34:48Z - elevated p95 on hosted-usw2 text-gen. Ticket INC-2024-314
maya: p95 drifted from ~320ms -> ~1.2s at ~09:32 UTC for model:redwood-open-3q (quant path). Seeing more short sequences mixed with long ones.
luca: selector metric trace shows frequent kernel flips. Kernel churn forces small batches because worker path switches, see snippet: 
```
2024-10-12T09:32:55Z selector: req 22105 -> fp16_kern v4
2024-10-12T09:32:56Z selector: req 22109 -> compact_kern v2
2024-10-12T09:32:56Z selector: req 22112 -> fp16_kern v4
```
anil: KV cache graphs show eviction surge on hosts serving shard-21..23, miss_rate jumped 20%->58% coincident with churn. Hot-tenant behavior suspected.
maya: churn + cache misses -> batching collapse and p95 tail. We should apply short mitigations: lock kernel_autoswitch=false for region:us-west-2, bump max_batch_wait to 6ms to allow batches to form, and route heavy tenants to a lite model. Agree?
jolie: I'll run it. Steps: 1) /ops feature-flag set kernel_autoswitch=false --scope=region:us-west-2 --reason="INC-2024-314" 2) /ops runtime-config set max_batch_wait=6ms --scope=region:us-west-2 --reason="incident" 3) /ops routing canary --from=model:redwood-open-3q --to=model:redwood-open-3q-lite --percent=25 --scope=tenant:top-noisy --reason="INC-2024-314 mitigations"
ops-bot: Feature-flag change queued: kernel_autoswitch=false (ff-9007) by jolie
ops-bot: Feature-flag ff-9007 applied to hosts in region:us-west-2 - SUCCESS
ops-bot: Runtime config updated: max_batch_wait=6ms applied - SUCCESS
ops-bot: Canary created r-10021: 25% traffic tenant:top-noisy -> redwood-open-3q-lite
luca: selector logs now stable, compact_kern used consistently for last 45s. Batches regained size (median batch tokens up from 6 -> 18).
anil: KV miss rate on shard-21..23 trending down 58% -> 27% after prefill and churn reduction. Prefill job for affected shards started (prefill-211).
maya: dashboard shows p95 dropped to ~370ms within ~90s of mitigations. Throughput steady.
jolie: documenting runbook actions: ff-9007, r-10021, prefill-211, max_batch_wait bump. Will attach traces to INC-2024-314.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-314 status -> Mitigated. Mitigations applied: ff-9007, r-10021, prefill-211.
maya: follow-ups: 1) selector: add dwell-time (30s) and hysteresis to avoid rapid flips 2) batcher: add adaptive min-batch-size when kernel flips detected 3) create KV-churn regression test simulating hot-tenant eviction patterns.
luca: +1 on dwell-time PR, I'll add unit + integration tests simulating seq-length bursts.
anil: I'll own the KV churn perf test and add it to nightly gate.
jolie: filing follow-ups and drafting post-incident notes. Closing thread for now.
maya: :thumbsup: nice quick coordination
luca: :shipit:
anil: marking for postmortem and follow-ups
